_doc: Bro & Bhai ep 01: Claude Code Game Studios. The user's master prompt (TPT-20261030-1200-01) is the spec: its 54 s VO is read VERBATIM, 18 lines in fixed 3 s slots (slot = line index * 3 s); only the speaker split is ours. 'cap' = Roman caption (the prompt's exact VO line), 'type' = the prompt's on-screen TYPE, 'tts' = what the voice reads (Devanagari Hindi + English words; numbers spoken in English, as the prompt's 'Fifteen hooks'; Claude = क्लॉड, QA = क्यू-ए, roles = रोल्स so STT hears them right). Optional per-line 'speed' / 'seed' override the speaker's. Claims: docs/factcheck.md.
